test1_exposure_frozen.note: frozen per-fold rules (thresholds and hyper-parameters chosen on training patients with full histories) evaluated on truncated held-out histories; non-progressor follow-up for flags per patient-year = first endoscopy to the first dropped endoscopy; draws averaged as fractional patient outcomes, then the paired patient bootstrap

first_endoscopy_only_fixed_cn90.note: only each patient's first pre-event endoscopy is evaluated (memory = that endoscopy alone; ACE-B-like); the certificate cannot act

test8_batch.note: consecutive pre-event endoscopies within patient; |change| of the repeat-mean logit max L-IMG and of the median R49-aligned gate score (0 = flag boundary); flip = gate flag differs; endoscopy scanner / sequencing batch = commonest over its samples; OLS with patient-clustered SEs; ICC(1) on repeat-mean scores, adjusted = residuals on scanner (and batch) fixed effects
